findings.claim: Event 20161 is a READBACK_VERIFICADO inventory-only evidence snapshot for M10.9, created 2026-10-04; it is not current certification.

Current principal is supabase_read_only_user with transaction_read_only=on; it cannot execute fn_input_governance_execute, although it can execute the engineering checkpoint transition function. No transition was invoked.

Across 255 pre-cut readiness rows, curator identity is present in all rows; validator identity is null in 7; no non-null row has equal curator/validator identity. Components have 3/8 nulls and no equal non-null component IDs.
Event 20161 has migration_batch_id null and created_by_execution_id CHATGPT-IG-M10.9-20261004-001.
No row in public.lf_operation_execution matches that created_by_execution_id.

assumptions.text: Recorded identity inequality is not equivalent to material execution independence.
Absence from public.lf_operation_execution does not prove absence from every possible historical authority ledger.
Read-only identity and privilege results describe this session only.
Inventory-only event scope must not be promoted to current functional attestation.

justifications.claim: P0 is historical inventory evidence, not current certification
Current research session cannot execute IG runtime
Recorded Curator/Validator fields are distinct where both exist
Canonical operation linkage is not visible in public.lf_operation_execution

propagation.result: Downgrade identity separation to label-level evidence only.
Replace authority-link gap with legacy/external linkage and re-evaluate provenance.
Use the newer governed attestation for current authority; keep P0 historical.

alternative_supports: Material independence needs execution provenance, principal/session boundaries and input/output separation, not labels alone.

E.rationale: The read-only boundary is clear and historical provenance fields are visible, but material actor independence and canonical event authority are not fully attested.
potential_falsifiers: A canonical historical ledger binds event 20161 to an authorized operation.
Material execution provenance proves independent Curator/Validator principals/sessions.
A governed current receipt supersedes the historical inventory evidence.

reversal_criteria.to_REPAIR_REQUIRED: A real authority bypass or invalid attestation is proven.
reversal_criteria.to_NO_ACTION_SUPPORTED: Canonical provenance and material independence are fully attested.

negative_falsifiers: Do not equate distinct identity strings with material independence.
Do not infer global execution inability from this read-only principal.
Do not infer absence of all provenance from one unmatched ledger.
Do not promote an inventory-only 2026-10-04 event to current certification.
